"""Offline adverse-event reporting cue extraction.

Detects advisory adverse event / SAE cues from title/abstract/methods via
deterministic patterns. Never calls the network. Distinct from
:class:`~retrieval.blinding_status_cues.BlindingStatusCueExtractor` and
:class:`~retrieval.publication_bias_cues.PublicationBiasCueExtractor`.
Fills an Elicit / Consensus / Cochrane adverse-event reporting gap.
Optional later narrative can use GPT-5.5 / Claude Sonnet 4.6 / Gemini 3.x /
Kimi K2.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass

_TEXT_FIELDS = ("abstract", "title", "summary", "methods", "method", "results", "safety")

_PATTERNS: tuple[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str]], ...] = (
    (
        "serious_adverse_event",
        re.compile(r"\bserious adverse events?\b|\bSAEs?\b", re.IGNORECASE),
    ),
    (
        "adverse_event",
        re.compile(r"\badverse events?\b|\btreatment[- ]emergent\b", re.IGNORECASE),
    ),
    (
        "safety_endpoint",
        re.compile(r"\bsafety (?:endpoint|outcome|profile)\b|\btolerability\b", re.IGNORECASE),
    ),
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AdverseEventCue:
    """Advisory adverse-event cues for one paper row."""

    paper_id: str
    adverse_kind: str | None
    cues: tuple[str, ...]
    matched: tuple[str, ...]
    flagged: bool


class AdverseEventCueExtractor:
    """Extract adverse-event reporting cues offline."""

name = "scholar-rag-agent"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Production-grade Agentic RAG for scientific literature with multi-hop reasoning and multi-LLM routing."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
license = { text = "Apache-2.0" }
authors = [{ name = "Scholar RAG Agent Contributors" }]
keywords = ["agentic-rag", "graphrag", "scientific-ai", "llm-agents", "retrieval-augmented-generation"]
dependencies = [
  "defusedxml>=0.7.1",
  "fastapi>=0.111.0",
  "httpx>=0.27.0",
  "pydantic>=2.7.0",
  "pydantic-settings>=2.2.1",
  "pypdf>=4.2.0",
  "python-multipart>=0.0.9",
  "uvicorn>=0.30.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
all = ["spacy>=3.7.0", "sentence-transformers>=3.0.0"]
dev = [
  "hatchling",
  "mypy>=1.10.0",
  "pytest>=8.2.0",
  "pytest-asyncio>=0.23.0",
  "pytest-cov>=5.0.0",
  "ruff>=0.5.0",
  "pillow>=10.3.0",
]

[project.scripts]
scholar-rag-api = "api.main:main"
scholar-rag-ingest = "scripts.ingest_papers:main"
scholar-rag-eval = "scripts.evaluate_retrieval:main"

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = [
  "src/agent",
  "src/api",
  "src/ingestion",
  "src/llm",
  "src/retrieval",
  "src/storage",
  "src/evaluation",
  "scripts",
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include]
"src/config.py" = "config.py"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = "-q"
asyncio_mode = "auto"
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"
src = ["src", "tests", "scripts"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "B", "UP", "N", "ANN", "ASYNC", "S", "C4", "SIM", "RUF"]
ignore = ["S101"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"tests/**/*.py" = ["S101"]
"scripts/*.py" = ["S603", "S607"]
"src/storage/graph_store.py" = ["S608"]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.11"
strict = true
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
ignore_missing_imports = true
plugins = []
exclude = ["tests"]

"""Acceptance check for PR #204: AdverseEventCueExtractor."""

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "src")

from dataclasses import fields as dataclass_fields
from retrieval.adverse_event_cues import AdverseEventCue, AdverseEventCueExtractor


def test_module_imports():
    """The module can be imported without errors."""
    from retrieval import adverse_event_cues  # noqa: F401


def test_extractor_class_exists():
    """AdverseEventCueExtractor class exists and has extract method."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    assert hasattr(extractor, "extract")
    assert callable(extractor.extract)


def test_empty_input_returns_empty_tuple():
    """Empty input returns empty tuple."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    result = extractor.extract([])
    assert result == ()


def test_detects_serious_adverse_event():
    """Detects 'serious adverse event' and 'SAE' patterns."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "paper_id": "test-1",
            "title": "A study of serious adverse events in treatment",
            "abstract": "We observed SAEs in 5% of patients.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    cue = result[0]
    assert cue.paper_id == "test-1"
    assert "serious_adverse_event" in cue.cues
    assert cue.flagged is True


def test_detects_adverse_event():
    """Detects 'adverse event' and 'treatment-emergent' patterns."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "id": "test-2",
            "abstract": "Adverse events were recorded daily.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    cue = result[0]
    assert cue.paper_id == "test-2"
    assert "adverse_event" in cue.cues
    assert cue.flagged is True


def test_detects_safety_endpoint():
    """Detects 'safety endpoint', 'safety outcome', 'safety profile', and 'tolerability' patterns."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "doi": "test-3",
            "methods": "The primary safety endpoint was defined as incidence of adverse events.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    cue = result[0]
    assert cue.paper_id == "test-3"
    assert "safety_endpoint" in cue.cues
    assert cue.flagged is True


def test_no_match_returns_unflagged():
    """Papers without adverse event cues are unflagged with empty cues."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "document_id": "test-4",
            "title": "A study on efficacy outcomes",
            "abstract": "No safety concerns were reported.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    cue = result[0]
    assert cue.paper_id == "test-4"
    assert cue.cues == ()
    assert cue.matched == ()
    assert cue.flagged is False
    assert cue.adverse_kind is None


def test_adverse_event_cue_dataclass_fields():
    """AdverseEventCue has the expected dataclass fields."""
    expected = {"paper_id", "adverse_kind", "cues", "matched", "flagged"}
    actual = {f.name for f in dataclass_fields(AdverseEventCue)}
    assert expected == actual


def test_multiple_papers():
    """Extracts cues from multiple papers correctly."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "p1", "abstract": "SAEs were observed."},
        {"paper_id": "p2", "abstract": "No adverse events reported."},
        {"paper_id": "p3", "abstract": "Tolerability was assessed."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 3
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert result[1].flagged is False
    assert result[2].flagged is True


def test_case_insensitive():
    """Pattern matching is case-insensitive."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "ci-test", "abstract": "SERIOUS ADVERSE EVENTS and AEs were recorded."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "serious_adverse_event" in result[0].cues


def test_text_fields_collected():
    """Text from multiple fields (title, abstract, methods, etc.) is collected."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {
            "paper_id": "multi-field",
            "title": "A study",
            "abstract": "No events here.",
            "methods": "We monitored for adverse events closely.",
        }
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "adverse_event" in result[0].cues


def test_treatment_emergent_pattern():
    """Detects 'treatment-emergent' and 'treatment emergent' patterns."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "te-test", "abstract": "Treatment-emergent adverse events were common."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "adverse_event" in result[0].cues


def test_safety_profile_pattern():
    """Detects 'safety profile' pattern."""
    extractor = AdverseEventCueExtractor()
    papers = [
        {"paper_id": "sp-test", "abstract": "The safety profile was acceptable."},
    ]
    result = extractor.extract(papers)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0].flagged is True
    assert "safety_endpoint" in result[0].cues


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import pytest
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])
